correctness.rationale: Addition theorem on S3 gives Chebyshev U_l Gram. Antipodal compression reduces to 24x24; exact normalized dot-products yield periodic values at 0, 1/2, 1/sqrt2. Every even l>=24 has diagonal l+1>23 off-diagonal row-sum; every odd l>=19 has l+1>=20>11+6sqrt(2), hence positive definite. Independent exact fraction/integer-conjugated Gram elimination reproduced all 23 low-degree ranks. The certified tail uses diagonal dominance, not extrapolated enumeration; F4 short/long roots both individually normalized.
